sources.title: Jak za dawnych lat

sources.researchNote: The photograph on page 15 is captioned in the article as the roof turret of Wilcza 29, but the depicted turret belongs to the neighbouring tenement at Wilcza 29A, designed by Wacław Heppen and Józef Napoleon Czerwiński. Wilcza 29 and 29A are distinct historical and present-day addresses; post-war documentation of Wilcza 29 is preserved separately in the Archive of the Capital City Reconstruction Office (APW, file 5069). The photograph therefore documents the immediate architectural context of Kaper's recorded address, not the residence itself.
